why.retreat: measured: median health at a mid-fight heal trip (3,109 trips); also the best pace Spearman of the grid
why.heal_frac: fitted (grid 0.3-0.95): the top teams go home after a capture 59% of the time at a median health of 0.93, so health does not separate the decision; 0.9 keeps the model going home after most jobs
why.bank_bag: fitted to the real bank sizes (median 26 gems over 24,945 banks): bag 20 gives the model's median bank 28
why.shop_gold: measured: median unspent gold at a shop visit after a recall with an empty bag (18,572 visits)
why.gold_w: measured: the top teams' next-group choice (12,000 choices; gems, gold, walk, health, heavy) values 1 gold as 0.020 gems
why.pace_gold_w: the same measurement (it equals the old default)
why.dmg_mult: fitted to the real kill durations (1-2 attacker kills, 43,782 episodes): 1.3 makes the model's median kill time equal
why.contest: LEARNED logistic of the team's capture share of a group on (their walk - ours) / band, all ladder captures; the pace check uses out-of-fold coefficients
